caption: The model's two students, Ravi and Meera, each have a Reads edge to a book (book1 and book2), so ∀x(Student(x) → ∃y(Book(y) ∧ Reads(x,y))) is true. Gita, book1 and book2 are not students, so their implications are vacuously true.

spec.aria: A first-order model graph: Ravi and Meera are students, Gita is not a student, book1 and book2 are books, and Reads edges go from Ravi to book1 and from Meera to book2.
